verdict.summary: The change is documentation plus a real fail-closed regression test; it does not alter reprojection behavior. The new test exercises the public lookup and conversion paths for all eight empty-WKT entries and correctly pins their refusal. The verification record supplies a reproducible registry comparison, distinguishes empty from non-empty no-AXIS entries, avoids licensing an unsupported coordinate swap, and keeps the residual unverifiable cases explicitly scoped. The claims are consistent with the existing axis gate and the embedded definitions.
